## New scientific proposal and literature context

The new proposal uses simultaneous differences to eliminate an additive shared
time term, then bounds benefit over every compatible sky contrast. This exact
score, deterministic residual bound, synthetic population and contrast target
are new choices awaiting owner review. The literature below motivates the
question and identifies assumptions; it does not authorize the method or
establish its applicability to Citlali.

Keihänen et al., *A maximum likelihood approach to the destriping technique*
(A&A 428, 287–298, 2004), model correlated noise together with sky and emphasize
repeated observations in controlling systematic effects. Their Planck setting
does not establish a same-time common additive residual model for TolTEC.
[Publisher's paper in the authors' institutional repository](https://air.unimi.it/retrieve/dfa8b996-ddf8-748b-e053-3a05fe0a3a96/aa3886.pdf).

Batson and Royer, *Noise2Self: Blind Denoising by Self-Supervision* (PMLR 97,
2019), rely on independence of noise across measurement dimensions when
estimating performance without clean observations. We do not assume such
independence for these processed measurements or adopt their denoiser.
[Primary paper and proceedings record](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v97/batson19a.html).

The simultaneous-difference construction here is a proposed inference from
the explicit toy model. Sky-shaped contamination remains indistinguishable
from true sky without additional information. S13 makes that limitation a
required reported result, even if all model-conditional tests succeed.

## Input and access boundary

There are **no external observational data inputs** to the proposed test.
The complete scientific input recipe is the 13 fixtures and four integrity
transformations in the design. Exact rational fixture files will be generated
and registered after approval. This step cannot add scientific cases or alter
the approved values. Old maps, spools, checkpoints, injection histories and
outcome tables are evidence for proposal preparation, not predictor inputs.
No new score, fixture execution or observation outcome was computed during
preparation. Algebraic examples in the design specify prospective checks.

Prior to any later real-data use, a separate owner-review design must supply:

- evidence that row indices identify simultaneous samples within the chosen
  array and scan, with known detector calibration/response;
- a defensible model and error bound for the processed donor residuals,
  including their correlations and possible sky-dependent contamination;
- a sky-sampling/transfer operator and comparison target appropriate to actual
  cleaning and signed JINC deposition, without circular use of an observed
  map as independent truth;
- a complete causal eligible census, support/conditioning treatment, attainable
  astronomical benefit endpoint and a bounded development population.

No raw-data access, retained-spool scoring, new reduction, production edit,
intervention, Unity use or qualification access is covered by this proposal.
Future end-to-end work must preserve source recovery, morphology, residual
leakage, support, useful-exclusion, convergence, runtime and memory metrics,
and require independent-pointing replication before policy recommendation.
